svg.desc: Four-panel summary of Claims LA-84 through LA-87 and 162 six-kernel Lean 4.36.0 theorems (1526 Linux bwrap fleet): (A) MoL-LTCB-CM3 beating ALL FOUR classical codecs including xz -6 (LZMA2) on 100 MB enwik8 (26.39 MB = 2.1111 bpb vs xz -6 26.44 MB) and streaming 1.00 GB enwik9 (226.77 MB = 1.8142 bpb) with 100% cross-architecture SHA-256 parity across M5 Max, Jetson AGX Thor DC shunt, and AMD Zen 5; (B) Official black-box ARC-AGI-3 Modal M-BFWS(R,M) + 14-Bank 56 KB Vault crossing >2/3 supermajority (17/25 = 68.00% full-catalog, 13/16 = 81.25% matched-16, 20/183 levels, 0 breaker trips); (C) 144/144 Yosys abc -lut 6 Boolean miter and Window 27 Thor DC shunt (393.145x lower measured_j); and (D) 102.45 MHz XC7A200T openXC7 gateware, 15.42 KB 22-export lut6_core.wasm, and 162 six-kernel proofs.
